about: Vectors of nenrin-verify --bitcoin-header (furui-day step 7, resume-admission step 6, and the step alone as command bitcoin-header). Python and JavaScript run this file and must give the same expect; the Go and Java ports take the flag in their next version. The explorers are answered by each world. The real header of block 970879 is as mempool.space and blockstream.info served it on 2026-11-03; the other headers are made up, with the easiest bits.
